cards.name: Script Events Manager
cards.summary: Runs Adobe's installed Script Events Manager.jsx, which opens a dialog for attaching a script or an action to a Photoshop event (Start Application, New Document, Open Document, Save Document, Close Document, Print Document, Export Document, Everything, or a custom event), so it runs automatically every time that event fires. Works with or without a document open.
cards.how: Tick Enable Events to Run Scripts/Actions first (nothing fires without it). Pick the Photoshop Event, then either Script (one of the bundled event scripts such as Save Extra JPEG, Resize, Update File Info, Warn if RGB, Clean Listener, or Browse... for your own .jsx) or Action (action set and action name). Add puts the pairing in the list; Remove / Remove All clear pairings. Pairings persist across sessions until removed.
use_for: automatically saving a flattened JPEG proof next to every PSD when it is saved
warning when an RGB file is opened in a CMYK print workflow
running a house-style action (guides, colour settings) on every new document
avoid: one-off batch work on a folder of files: use File > Automate > Batch or Image Processor instead of a permanent event hook
leaving a heavy action on Everything or Open Document: it slows every open and is easy to forget; remove pairings when the job ends
cards.script_api: $.evalFile(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Photoshop 2026/Presets/Scripts/Script Events Manager.jsx")) runs the installed script (invoke.file), which opens its dialog (not run in the harvest). Without the dialog (unverified): app.notifiersEnabled = true; app.notifiers.add("save", new File("<event script>.jsx")).

cards.name: Statistics
cards.summary: Runs Adobe's installed Statistics.jsx, which opens the Image Statistics dialog: it loads a set of images into one new document as a single smart object and applies a stack mode (Mean, Median, Maximum, Minimum, Range, Variance, Standard Deviation, Summation, Entropy, Kurtosis, Skewness) that combines them pixel by pixel. Median of several shots of the same scene removes moving people; Mean averages away noise.
cards.how: Choose Stack Mode, then pick sources with Use (Files, Folder or Open Files) and Browse / Add Open Files. Tick Attempt to Automatically Align Source Images for hand-held shots. The result is a smart object whose stack mode can be changed later in Layer > Smart Objects > Stack Mode.
use_for: removing tourists and cars from a landmark shot taken as a burst on a tripod (Median)
cleaning noise from a low-light product shot by averaging several identical frames (Mean)
building light-trail or star-trail composites from a sequence (Maximum)
avoid: images that are not the same framing and exposure: the stack smears; align first or shoot on a tripod
plain layering of different images for a collage: use File > Scripts > Load Files into Stack, which keeps separate layers
cards.script_api: $.evalFile(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Photoshop 2026/Presets/Scripts/Statistics.jsx")) runs the installed script (invoke.file), which opens the Image Statistics dialog (not run in the harvest). Without the dialog (unverified as a chain): stack the images as layers (File/Scripts/Load Files into Stack), convert them to one smart object with app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID("newPlacedLayer")), then apply the Layer/Smart Objects/Stack Mode/<mode> event: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID("applyImageStackPluginRenderer"), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc imageStackPlugin (class) = the mode, e.g. charIDToTypeID("medn"), and name (string) = "Median" (the route the Stack Mode cards verified live).

review.changes: script_api: the no-dialog route used executeAction(newPlacedLayer) and a bare menu path; replaced with the harvest-verified runMenuItem(newPlacedLayer) and applyImageStackPluginRenderer calls from the Convert to Smart Object and Stack Mode items

cards.name: Search Adobe Express Templates
cards.summary: Opens Adobe's search for Adobe Express templates (ready-made social posts, flyers, banners) so one can be picked as a starting point. The harvest classed it as opening web content and did not run it, so whether the chosen template opens as a layered Photoshop document or in Adobe Express was not observed. Works with no document open.
use_for: finding a quick starting layout for a social post or flyer when there is no brand template
browsing current template trends for a reference board
avoid: brand-locked work: a stock template rarely matches brand fonts and grids; build from the brand's own PSD/PSDT templates
unattended pipelines: it needs a signed-in user and web content, with no script route

cards.name: Share for Review
cards.summary: Creates a web review link for the open document: Photoshop uploads a review copy to Adobe's cloud, and anyone with the link can view it in a browser and leave pinned comments, which come back into Photoshop's Comments panel. Needs an open document (disabled with none open).
cards.how: Set the link name and who can access it, create the link, then copy and send it. After edits, update the shared version from the same dialog so reviewers see the latest; read and resolve feedback in the Comments panel.
use_for: getting client sign-off on a poster or banner comp without emailing exports
collecting art-director comments pinned to exact spots of a layout
avoid: files under NDA or client contracts that forbid cloud uploads: export a proof and share it through the approved channel
final print hand-off: reviewers see a web preview, not a press-ready PDF; use File > Save a Copy as Photoshop PDF

cards.name: Version History
cards.summary: Opens the Version History panel, which lists the saved versions of the current cloud document with their times; a version can be previewed, bookmarked (kept permanently) or reverted to / opened as a copy. Enabled even with no document open, in which case the panel has nothing to list; whether local PSD files get versions in this release was not checked by the harvest.
use_for: going back to the layout the client approved two rounds ago
bookmarking the approved version of a campaign file before more edits
avoid: undoing recent steps within a session: use the History panel or Undo
local PSD files as a backup strategy: keep dated copies or version control; unbookmarked cloud versions are only kept for a limited time
